one_line_answer.text: Maintenance is performing the routine actions which keep the device in working order, to keep in good condition, to preserve and protect the device.

cites.quote: Maintenance is performing the routine actions which keep the device in working order, to keep in good condition, to preserve and protect the device.

keywords.bn: চালু ও কাজ করার মতো অবস্থা

bangla_explanation: Maintenance মানে device-কে নিয়মিত যত্ন করা, যাতে সেটা working order-এ থাকে।
এর কাজ চারটা: চালু রাখা, ভালো অবস্থায় রাখা, preserve করা আর protect করা।
Repair আলাদা জিনিস: জিনিস নষ্ট হলে তখন ঠিক করা, "fix it when it breaks"।
পরীক্ষায় "Define maintenance" এলে উপরের সংজ্ঞাটা হুবহু লিখুন।

example.en: In an IT training centre, staff clean the computers every week. This keeps them in working order.
example.bn: কম্পিউটার নষ্ট হওয়ার আগেই নিয়মিত পরিষ্কার করা হলো maintenance।

traps.text: Repair is different: fix a device when it is out of order or broken.

cites.quote: Repair is fixing any sort of mechanical or electrical device should it become out of
order or broken: "fix it when it breaks.

traps.text: Other definition: all actions to retain or restore an item to perform its required function.

cites.quote: All actions which have as an objective to retain an item in or restore it to, a
state in which it can perform the required function.

short.modelAnswer:
Maintenance is performing the routine actions which keep the device in working order, to keep in good condition, to preserve and protect the device.
So maintenance:
1. keeps the device in working order
2. keeps it in good condition
3. preserves and protects the device
